title: Plan package installers and SDK stability gates
summary: After the source alpha installer lands, distribution still needs a staged package-installer, SDK-stability, signed-artifact, and upgrade-policy plan that separates implementable local checks from human-owned release approval.
expectedFailureModes: Package or SDK docs imply stable public support before release gates exist.
Readiness checks cannot distinguish local installer support from signed artifact publication.
Upgrade guidance omits rollback or compatibility boundaries for alpha operators.
humanEscalation: Human approval is required before tagging, signing, publishing package artifacts, or announcing SDK stability.
nextAction: Define the package and SDK graduation gates, add machine-checkable readiness output, and keep tag signing and artifact publication explicitly human-approved.
